reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, so I have an actual reason, and a named lab report for the batch plus an empty-box refund means I can try one box without much risk. At $24.99 I'd buy it once and see.
objection: Will I actually feel a difference? And it's made in China, so I'm relying on that lab report being real.
would_change_my_mind: If my doctor's blood test shows my magnesium is normal, I would not buy it.
